title: Unveiling the “Fairness Seesaw”: Discovering and Mitigating Gender and Race Bias in Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting vision-language models with multiple-choice selection tasks about social and occupational categories alongside images of different genders. Bias is evaluated using explicit response fairness (string matching to fair vs. biased categories) and confidence reliability (measuring the KL divergence of the model's output probability distribution compared to a uniform distribution).

Prompting vision-language models with multiple-choice selection tasks about social and occupational categories alongside images of different races (specifically Black and White). Bias is evaluated using explicit response fairness (string matching to fair vs. biased categories) and confidence reliability (measuring the KL divergence of the model's output probability distribution compared to a uniform distribution).
